layers.title: Market data and reference
layers.requirement: Acquire licensed, source-identifiable US-equity observations; preserve feed, timestamps, identity and corporate actions; produce exact reproducible analytical snapshots and reject data whose historical availability or eligibility is unknown.
layers.current_choice: Official alpaca-py for the bounded selected market-data path; EdgarTools for selected filing parsing/acquisition; DuckDB and Parquet for local analysis; exchange_calendars for explicit session semantics. Dataset manifests and schema checks are requirements, while DVC/Pandera remain source-reviewed implementation candidates.
layers.rationale: Derived from domain row data-research (2026-09-22): Native acquisition, parsing and analytical receipts support these concrete interfaces without a new lake, broker or distributed database. They do not close the actual research bottleneck: a complete point-in-time eligible universe with trustworthy availability, identity and corporate-action semantics. Source-review defaults for DVC/Pandera must not be mistaken for installed acceptance. Databento/Massive are credible conditional alternatives when required coverage or rights cannot be obtained through the selected path.
limitations: The authenticated Alpaca receipt covers 25 AAPL SIP/raw daily bars and two corporate actions over five successful pages, not a survivorship-free universe, complete history or real-time feed entitlement.

Three documentary lifecycle cases preserve observed cutoffs and source anchors; retrospective claims do not establish historical as-known eligibility or permanent security identity.
The prior SEC HTTP 403 remains a historical failure. Later corrected acquisition and parsing qualify their selected requests only; no general filing-completeness or strategy-validity claim follows.

layers.overturn_when: Freeze required universe/history/latency, rights, correction and availability semantics; compare selected providers on representative securities including delistings, ticker reuse and corporate actions, then change the feed/store only when a candidate closes those gaps with auditable records and acceptable measured cost. winners.why_selected: c2 (DVC) is a conditional default chosen by source-review fit only. No adopted candidate was executed, measured or integrated for this layer in any evidence I opened. I observed three things. (1) The packet card (packet lines 36-66) describes DVC as 'Git-linked hashes, data dependencies and experiment pipelines', pinned at 3.67.1 / source 356dfa03, Apache-2.0. Its limitation reads 'Content hashes prove identity, not data validity or point-in-time correctness' (line 39). Among the adopted candidates, only this role maps directly onto the data-versioning, provenance and reproducibility scope terms (packet lines 284-297) without a new server, table format or licence question. (2) The repository keeps an independent upstream source inspection of DVC. catalogs/us-equities/data-evaluation-followup.md line 46 cites treeverse/dvc at 56e59829 (dvc/stage/serialize.py and commands/repro.py) for 'data/parameter lock provenance when datasets branch'. That is a different revision from the packet pin 356dfa03, and the same line limits the value: 'Current receipts already cover the small workflow; hashes and dry runs do not prove PIT or data rights.' (3) The working provenance mechanism in this repository uses none of the candidates. It is the project's own DuckDB/Parquet ledger. Its manifest binds exact source, Parquet, bridge, helper and SQL bytes under external SHA-256 anchors (blueprints/us-equities/security-identity/README.md lines 138-144), with separate event, observed and available nanosecond axes. Historical validity and publication fields stay Unknown (lines 107-116) or NULL (lines 41-42 and 194-195). That ledger is documented design with synthetic offline tests, and I did not run it. DVC is therefore selected only as the lightest adopted way to version and lock those ledger artifacts once datasets branch. Its added value over the existing SHA-256 anchors has not been demonstrated, and the availability-cutoff and eligibility rejection logic stays in project code. I did not use the withheld review_status label (packet line 326) as a basis for selection.

Three documentary lifecycle cases preserve observed cutoffs and source anchors; retrospective claims do not establish historical as-known eligibility or permanent security identity.

layers.requirement: Run bounded research with native identity and complete returned results; supervise owned processes; retain scoped telemetry, failed attempts and recoverable state without granting research workers broker execution authority.
layers.current_choice: Native Codex and Claude for bounded research and review; Dagu/systemd for selected local command workflows; one OpenTelemetry Collector with Prometheus/Loki/Grafana; native sandboxing and Restic for their separately qualified scopes. Optional gateways and agent frameworks remain task-specific.
layers.rationale: Derived from domain row agents-operations (2026-09-22): The retained native lane has actual task results, process/usage observations and local command workflow history. Adding an agent framework or gateway by default would not close a demonstrated requirement and can alter account identity, tool behavior or retry ownership. Dagu's accepted local scope fits existing commands; larger workflow and data platforms become preferable only when their durability, partitioning or operational requirements are real.
limitations: Native worker success and telemetry matching are bounded by the recorded task, process and account. They do not establish every native client/session, whole-task savings or unlimited allowance.
Dagu's older completed-history restart is not in-flight recovery. Later recovery receipts must be evaluated for their own process, host and workload rather than promoting all workflows.
Gateway transport health, routed text and ACP research acceptance do not establish native hook/tool parity or independent provider/model attestation.
Same-host recovery and configured restrictions do not establish off-host disaster recovery, a VM boundary, unattended broker operation or paid hosting.
The us-equities catalog also tags entries for this taxonomy layer under data-research (2); agents-operations (7) was picked as the primary group by entry count.
layers.overturn_when: Escalate to another scheduler, graph or host only when a specified long-running workflow, host-loss recovery, asset/backfill lineage or scale requirement exceeds the retained lane and the candidate passes the same failure, cancellation, output, identity and usage checks without duplicate effect owners.

Run the Nautilus SPY one_zero parity comparison defined in blueprints/us-equities/engine-nautilus/acceptance-plan.md sections 2-3 against the frozen LEAN oracle.

The oracle is the one_zero case in blueprints/us-equities/historical-simulation/plan.json and receipt.json. Pass criteria from acceptance-plan.md lines 122-150:
- Exactly 4 events, matching exactly: entry intent at 1577826000 for 304 shares, entry fill at 1577977200 for 304 shares at 323.58, exit intent at 1588190400 for -304 shares, and exit fill at 1588255200 for -304 shares at 291.69.
- Distributions of $428.64 and final cash of $90,734.08, with at most $0.01 absolute tolerance on exported balances.
- Equal economic records across two fresh runs.

layers.title: Execution and broker adapters
layers.requirement: Use the selected NautilusTrader destination with broker-specific execution boundaries, deterministic numeric risk and reproducible equity accounting; preserve the prior LEAN oracle and qualify any strategy with causal data, costs and independent reconciliation.
layers.current_choice: NautilusTrader 2.0.0rc5 is the user-selected destination; LEAN remains the retained historical comparison engine. Nautilus native IBKR awaits broker acceptance; Alpaca uses official alpaca-py and a separately qualified deterministic paper path. No strategy is promoted as profitable.
layers.rationale: Derived from domain row engines-strategies (2026-09-22): The current choice follows the explicit runtime target and supported native IBKR direction, with real installation/replay and bounded AAPL accounting evidence. LEAN has deeper retained SPY stress/dividend/cash evidence and is kept as the comparison oracle rather than relabeled a losing engine. The AAPL diagnostic and one Alpaca paper roundtrip do not prove SPY parity, realistic liquidity, IBKR operation, continuous paper service or a winning strategy. Existing research modules remain task-specific.
limitations: Nautilus 2.0.0rc5 is a prerelease. The old September 19 Nautilus alternative and LEAN default cards remain historical; runtime-target.json governs the current destination.

The retained AAPL replay has 15 bars and five roundtrips per baseline/stress scenario with reconciled cash; it excludes known action dates and uses retrospective synthetic close fills with unlimited modeled depth.
SPY/LEAN dividend/cash parity is still planned. LEAN's known-crash fixtures are engineering stresses, not untouched holdout results or calibrated broker execution.

The Alpaca trial observed two actual writes, a -0.08 USD cash-matched gross result, flat/idle reconciliation and completed-trial recovery with zero additional writes. In-flight native failure cases, IBKR, live operation and continuous paper operation remain open.
No accepted point-in-time universe, extreme-mover/catalyst strategy, financing-inclusive performance or deployable profitability follows from these receipts.

Independent source review found two bare matches! expressions that do not assert denial-event variants in Nautilus risk tests, also present in v2.0.0rc5 source. Other tests assert denial and reasons. This narrow test defect is not an observed runtime failure; see docs/blind-catalog-source-adjudication-20260921.md.
The us-equities catalog also tags entries for this taxonomy layer under data-research (1); engines-strategies (5) was picked as the primary group by entry count.
layers.overturn_when: Reopen the implementation choice if Nautilus cannot preserve a required cash/order semantic, fails a preregistered SPY/LEAN parity tolerance, or a broker-specific adapter cannot pass ownership, reconciliation, partial/cancel/reconnect and numeric risk cases. Compare alternatives on the same frozen inputs and failure contract; promote a strategy only after independent temporal and cost-aware evaluation.

layers.title: Agents, models and workers
layers.requirement: Keep durable project knowledge, exact code and dated financial sources retrievable across native clients, with source recovery, explicit project scope and measurable retrieval quality.
layers.current_choice: ai-memory as the shared memory of record; QMD BM25 for documents; Serena for exact symbols; SocratiCode with Qdrant for conceptual code search; Context Mode and RTK for selected large outputs. These are complementary lanes, not one benchmark winner.
layers.rationale: Derived from domain row foundation-memory (2026-09-22): The selected lanes have native operation and recovery evidence on the existing host and avoid making every lookup depend on another extraction model or service. The measured QMD domain fixture returned the intended source in the first three results for 8 of 12 queries, so its low setup cost supports retention while the four misses require a representative comparison before claiming retrieval superiority. Memory recall and code search receipts do not qualify financial answer truth or historical market availability.
limitations: Twelve curated queries are a bounded diagnostic, not an independent holdout or a complete financial RAG evaluation. Exact-source recall at three was 8/12; misses remain recorded.

The eight native answer invocations form four within-provider task comparisons; two Claude full-context answers missed the word protocol and one focused Codex answer scored 9.5 versus 10. These are not general or causal savings results.
Same-host encrypted restore preserved application state, but independent key recovery, off-host durability and new-host client rebinding remain unqualified.
Alternative memory and RAG repositories below were generally source-reviewed, not run head-to-head. A source-only candidate has not failed.

Current primary-source review corrects manual-only, Claude-only and cloud-only exclusions. No matched memory benchmark or new installation was run; automatic capture, local providers and published scores remain source claims until exercised on the selected profile.
The us-equities catalog also tags entries for this taxonomy layer under agents-operations (10); foundation-memory (28) was picked as the primary group by entry count.
layers.overturn_when: Run a preregistered, representative held-out financial/document and code retrieval set at the same context budget; replace or supplement a lane only if a candidate improves source/answer fidelity, abstention and measured task cost while preserving isolation, exact source recovery and native client behavior.

alternatives.name: Serena
alternatives.why_not_default: This is the exact-symbol and reference lane that complements c12's semantic search, and the requirement's 'exact code' clause fits it best. alternatives.name: omniroute
alternatives.why_not_default: The gateway completed one text-only Responses request: HTTP 200 with 81+55=136 tokens. Two failed attempts came first, a 400 version rejection and a 499 client disconnect, and their usage is unknown (astra-receipt.json attempts 1-3). The receipt states that model tools, hooks, MCP, memory, compaction and worker parity were not demonstrated, and that the native worker remains the default. The gateway strips max_output_tokens. health-receipt.json only checks status. The recipe script hardcodes its request file (omniroute-astra.py line 38), so it cannot run another task without an edit.

alternatives.name: deerflow
alternatives.why_not_default: The evidence is one embedded invoke_acp_agent research prompt: 31027 ms, 42345 cumulative tokens, correct counts returned. There was no DeerFlow planner, UI, scheduler or standing service. It ran development commit 42334f26 (backend 2.1.0-rc0), not stable v2.0.0. DeerFlow discards ACP usage, so usage came from private adapter logs. The task explicitly forbade MCP tools (deerflow/research-task.md line 3), so tool support through this route is untested. The earlier discovery receipt was model-free.

alternatives.name: codex-acp
alternatives.why_not_default: It worked as the ACP transport for the single DeerFlow prompt. ACP 1.12.0's read-only mode maps to workspaceWrite with approvalPolicy on-request, so strict filesystem read-only is not enforced (research-receipt.json limitations and sandbox_policy). For enforced read-only research, the hardcoded read-only launcher of the native SDK path (c20; workers/research-task.md line 10) is the one to use.

alternatives.name: Context Mode
alternatives.why_not_default: It is a tool-output lane, not durable or retrievable project knowledge. In native Codex, ctx_execute_file and ctx_stats succeeded (component-history.json line 117), and 11 direct Desktop tools were exposed (observability/restart-receipt.json). In the SDK worker, ctx_execute_file failed in all three recorded turns: workers/receipt.json lines 77, 163 and 200, the first failing on the project-root restriction (line 111). ctx_execute extraction completed. overturn_protocol.metric: Worker routes are measured on the same no-MCP task, deerflow/research-task.md, with these fields per route: exact-field correctness against the input receipts, strict filesystem read-only enforced (yes/no), model-identity evidence, and complete native usage including failed or blocked turns. Tool/MCP success is scored in a separate task that permits tools. Retrieval is exact intended-source recall@3 and abstention on a new held-out set with frozen queries and fixed gold, at a fixed context budget. The existing QMD BM25 run (8/12) is the format template and baseline, not a held-out set.

open_gaps: There is no measured head-to-head comparison between the worker routes (native SDK, DeerFlow/ACP, OmniRoute). Each ran a different single task, and the two task files differ: workers/research-task.md is an unfilled template, and deerflow/research-task.md forbids MCP tools. No route is established as a universal winner.

Native SDK worker: all three native turns completed, but only 1 of 3 tasks succeeded (successful_research_tasks 1, blocked_file_extraction_tasks 2; workers/receipt.json lines 218-219). ctx_execute_file failed in every turn. A general success rate is unestablished.
The configured model and provider identity is not an independent per-request provider attestation, and model-reroute notifications were not collected in the SDK run.

Retrieval quality for the winners is unmeasured. The only measurement is QMD BM25 recall@3 of 8/12 on 12 curated, non-holdout queries (retrieval-evaluation/README.md line 28; receipt.json line 706). The README says it does not evaluate SocratiCode or memory (line 141). SocratiCode evidence is one limit-1 query with score 0.6429.

No financial-document corpus with as-of, source or tenant metadata exists, and no dated financial-source retrieval was exercised. The requirement's 'dated financial sources' clause is unmet by all candidates.

c12 versus c9 for exact code retrieval is an unmeasured trade-off: c12 matches its pin and refreshes its index automatically, while c9 is the exact-symbol lane but runs a dev snapshot that differs from its pin.

Non-adopted newcomers c5 (loopx), c17 (beads) and c18 have no retained evidence, so they are not listed as alternatives. They are untested, not failed.
The read-only filesystem sandbox does not restrict inherited MCP or remote-tool mutation authority, so the broker-tool exclusion depends on the environment.

Change the c7/c12 verdict only if another candidate, run at the same context budget, improves exact-source recall@3 and abstention over ai-memory+SocratiCode, or over Serena for exact symbols. layers.requirement: Run bounded research with native identity and complete returned results; supervise owned processes; retain scoped telemetry, failed attempts and recoverable state without granting research workers broker execution authority.
layers.current_choice: Native Codex and Claude for bounded research and review; Dagu/systemd for selected local command workflows; one OpenTelemetry Collector with Prometheus/Loki/Grafana; native sandboxing and Restic for their separately qualified scopes. Optional gateways and agent frameworks remain task-specific.
layers.rationale: Derived from domain row agents-operations (2026-09-22): The retained native lane has actual task results, process/usage observations and local command workflow history. (2) The deduplicated SDK receipt total_tokens (baseline 80770) staying the same across a restart of both the collector and the storage backend.
(3) Historical metric and log retention after a backend restart, on real run telemetry rather than only synthetic data.
(4) Forbidden-marker absence on the privacy canary.
(5) A deliberately failed native run that is ingested and queryable with usage_status preserved.
(6) For the recovery arm only: a verified restore (check --read-data exit 0, independent byte match) that includes live Loki and Prometheus storage and an off-host copy, with the same queries answered afterward.

The failed-status handling is covered only by the offline tests/test_observability.py helper test.

The SDK receipt lane summarized 2 earlier receipts rather than making new model calls (observability/receipt.json line 248). The SDK native turn histogram was not observed (`native_turn_histogram_observed` false), including in a bounded flush experiment.

There is no high availability: all six services run as single-host WSL user services, and 'Single-host persistence is not replication or an off-host backup' (observability/backends/receipt.json line 106).

Telemetry is not backed up off-host. Restic covered 22 static public files only (`live_databases` 0), with `off_host_destination` false and key escrow `not_configured`. Restic retention ran only as a dry run, and no backup timer is enabled.
Traces are disabled and no trace database was deployed. phoenix and mlflow were never run.
The retained spool has no automatic expiry. Loss and recovery under a full disk or an extended backend outage were not tested (observability/receipt.json line 258).
Retention settings are configured but were not aged out during the check.
Alert delivery to external destinations was not tested (`external_delivery_tested` false).

The evidence does not show research workers being kept away from broker execution authority. sandbox-runtime proved filesystem restriction only; network denial and broker-credential isolation were not tested (evidence/receipts/runtime-tools.json).

Supervision of owned processes is not established. Dagu returned 401 without authentication, which 'proves expected anonymous protection, not authenticated workflow functionality' (observability/receipt.json lines 284-286).
No measured comparison against another telemetry stack was run. The winners were chosen by native acceptance, not by comparison.

domain_rows.title: Scoped memory and research retrieval
domain_rows.requirement: Keep durable project knowledge, exact code and dated financial sources retrievable across native clients, with source recovery, explicit project scope and measurable retrieval quality.
domain_rows.current_choice: ai-memory as the shared memory of record; QMD BM25 for documents; Serena for exact symbols; SocratiCode with Qdrant for conceptual code search; Context Mode and RTK for selected large outputs. These are complementary lanes, not one benchmark winner.
domain_rows.rationale: The selected lanes have native operation and recovery evidence on the existing host and avoid making every lookup depend on another extraction model or service. The measured QMD domain fixture returned the intended source in the first three results for 8 of 12 queries, so its low setup cost supports retention while the four misses require a representative comparison before claiming retrieval superiority. Memory recall and code search receipts do not qualify financial answer truth or historical market availability.
limitations: Twelve curated queries are a bounded diagnostic, not an independent holdout or a complete financial RAG evaluation. Exact-source recall at three was 8/12; misses remain recorded.

The eight native answer invocations form four within-provider task comparisons; two Claude full-context answers missed the word protocol and one focused Codex answer scored 9.5 versus 10. These are not general or causal savings results.
Same-host encrypted restore preserved application state, but independent key recovery, off-host durability and new-host client rebinding remain unqualified.
Alternative memory and RAG repositories below were generally source-reviewed, not run head-to-head. A source-only candidate has not failed.

Current primary-source review corrects manual-only, Claude-only and cloud-only exclusions. No matched memory benchmark or new installation was run; automatic capture, local providers and published scores remain source claims until exercised on the selected profile.
domain_rows.overturn_when: Run a preregistered, representative held-out financial/document and code retrieval set at the same context budget; replace or supplement a lane only if a candidate improves source/answer fidelity, abstention and measured task cost while preserving isolation, exact source recovery and native client behavior.

candidates.rationale: A structured factor/model experiment framework can help after a defensible US point-in-time dataset exists. Its broader workflow does not cure the current provenance/eligibility gaps or justify another active strategy stack yet.

candidates.name: FinRL
candidates.rationale: RL remains an experiment after deterministic and supervised baselines; no local out-of-sample, cost-aware strategy or execution qualification supports promoting it.

candidates.name: TradingAgents
candidates.rationale: The reviewed multi-agent financial analysis workflow is a research candidate. More agents and a simulated decision pipeline do not establish causal data, alpha or authority to bypass deterministic order/risk code.

candidates.name: PyPortfolioOpt
candidates.rationale: A smaller classical allocation module can be preferable when allocation alone is required. The selected skfolio study qualifies chronological evaluation, not a head-to-head proof that its optimizers dominate this candidate.

candidates.name: Dockerized IB Gateway
candidates.rationale: The selected Nautilus source supports optional DockerizedIBGateway alongside an external native TWS/Gateway. Image digest, sign-in, restart, API connectivity and broker reconciliation are not qualified; this is independent of Alpaca acceptance.
